purpose: The Glass header pill built from GlassKit: section words on a dark pill, one search knob, a profile pill and a gear. Games and Live are doors, not permanent words.

anatomy.note: Fully rounded dark glass, 6dp inset; words sit close.
19dp bold; active is brighter ink on a barely-there plate, never a bright fill.
48dp knob at the end of the pill.
Profile pill and gear sit outside the pill, right-aligned.

rules: LEFT/RIGHT step the words then the knob.
UP from the hero lands on the standing section.

platformDeltas.ios: Same pill; profile becomes the leading avatar outside the pill.
platformDeltas.windows: Keep the pill but allow a pointer hover on words.
